summary: A for loop repeats a block once for each value. range() gives a sequence of numbers to count with.
notes: range(1, 6) stops before 6, so it gives 1 to 5.
range(5) starts at 0 and gives 5 numbers: 0 to 4.
range(10, 0, -2) counts down by 2 and stops before 0.
pitfall: Writing range(1, 5) when you want 1 to 5 skips the last number. The stop value is never included.
